newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Salomon rates Russia Surgutneftegaz buy.
newsitem.headline: Salomon rates Russia Surgutneftegaz buy.

text.p: Salomon Bros rated Russian oil company AO Surgutneftegaz a buy, the investment bank said in a research note by Elena Merkoulova and Jeremy Hudson released on Friday.
Salomon said Surgutneftegaz's identifiable value was around $0.95. Surgut ordinary shares on the Russian Trading System fell to $0.745 on Friday from $0.785 at Thursday's close.

It said Surgut, Russia's second largest crude oil producer, was a lower risk investment than lead producer NK LUKoil, given Surgut's value as an upstream business without dependence on a refining and marketing view.
LUKoil plans to spend $1.1 billion on refinery investments over the next five years, with as-yet uncertain results, Salomon said.
